summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed an 8-K regarding the Fourth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Senior Secured Credit Agreement. This amendment extends the revolver availability period to June 2030, the maturity date to June 2031, increases the accordion capacity to $4.0125 billion, resets the minimum shareholders equity test, and reduces swingline and letter of credit sublimits. No special situation event such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring occurred.
